canonicality.finding: The live Stripe account has an enabled Render production webhook. It is not the deployed Supabase dreamledger-stripe-webhook-v3 function.

supabase_dreamledger_stripe_webhook_v3.finding: Deployed but no matching source path exists on the current main branch.

canonical_revenue_endpoint.finding: The live canonical revenue endpoint is stripe-revenue, not dreamledger-stripe-webhook-v3. Its deployed source persists stripe_webhook_events before downstream processing but still performs downstream commerce work inline before acknowledging.

columns: processed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
stripe_webhook_events.finding: No lease/retry/error fields exist on this table.

existing_execution_queue.finding: An existing commerce/settlement queue already provides durable leasing and SKIP LOCKED claiming. Creating another competing queue would be unnecessary.

inbox.queue_trigger_path: INSERT stripe_webhook_events -> AFTER INSERT trigger -> settlement_enqueue_webhook -> processed_webhook_events

critical_failure.finding: The durable queue trigger is only useful if stripe_webhook_events is inserted before downstream work. The deployed dreamledger-stripe-webhook-v3 writes the receipt only after its CUBE reconciliation work, so it is not a durable intake boundary.
critical_failure.additional_finding: The deployed stripe-revenue handler does insert stripe_webhook_events before downstream processing, but it then continues processing inline. This leaves a recoverable receipt but not a pure enqueue-and-ack webhook.
critical_failure.recommended_path: Preserve stripe_webhook_events as the event receipt/idempotency record and preserve processed_webhook_events as the existing execution queue. Refactor the canonical revenue endpoint toward verify -> durable receipt -> acknowledge, then let the existing queue consumer own downstream processing.

existing_consumer.claim_semantics: pending or expired processing rows, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
existing_consumer.finding: A commerce settlement worker already exists. It handles checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, payment_intent.succeeded and charge.refunded for marketplace settlement.

consumer_gap.finding: The existing settlement consumer does not reproduce the full stripe-revenue handler. The full revenue path also creates revenue_orders, event_ledger, entitlements, fulfillment_requests, economic_events and control_reconciliations. Therefore a pure enqueue refactor requires either moving those operations into a commerce worker or extracting shared idempotent processing code. Do not deploy a webhook-only refactor until this downstream ownership is implemented.

economic_model_task_trace.claim_rpc_semantics: Selects pending or expired leased task matching model_name/model_role with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, leases it and increments attempt_count/run_lease.
economic_model_task_trace.failure_point: Not observable from the connected cloud-only source because actual worker process execution and its environment/model endpoint were not executed in this trace.
